title: Global search shows Not Tracked for an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • The top-bar Search is the new global search, which is on by default for every account.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSNT-01) is untracked at {Location-A} (tracking off) and keeps 4 in its default bin as a shelf reference.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSNT-02) is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin; its number starts the same as {Part-A}'s.
custom_steps:
1. Click "Search" in the top bar.
  2. Type the start that {Part-A} and {Part-B} share (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSNT-0).
  3. Read the badge on each part result.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-B} shows its stock badge, "4 available". {Part-A} shows "Not Tracked" in the place of that badge, with no "available" figure.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R20, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows global search.
